o1: Enables protein phosphatase 2A binding activity. Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in embryo development; mitotic spindle assembly; protein localization to organelle; and sarcomere organization. Located in centrosome; M line; and I band. Is expressed in body-wall muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 36. Orthologous to human PPP2R3C (protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit B''gamma).
